status: Qualified native CUDA QKV/compressor/key/index/attention/output/SWA producer path from normalized resident x, with actual checkpoint parameters. Native whole-model admission, generation and vLLM parity remain open.

implementation.sequence: Already normalized resident F16 x -> Q_A/RMS q_res/Q_B and normalized/rotated KV -> owner compressor projections/windows -> unrotated latents -> index key projection/norm -> absolute-entry rotation of keys AND latents -> paged owner publication -> current index selection -> attention against PRE-update SWA/current KV -> grouped projection -> SWA update/completion-gated cursor commit.
implementation.ownership: All mutable scratch/rings/pools stay in the same existing native backend session request. Core/parameter weight handles remain backend-owned and immutable. Architecture anatomy supplies role bindings, dimensions and sharing. No model-family dispatch or raw GGUF dtype tags added to transformer.
implementation.metadata: Setup reads each owner BF16 compressor gamma once from immutable native storage and converts it to source F16. Allocates request-owned read-only norm views plus zero APE/frequency metadata for unrotated HCA compression. Setup scratch and payload are budgeted; no execution file reads or activation allocation/transfers.
implementation.causality: Begin once per full chunk before owner production. Borrowing layers require fresh owner extent/generation; gathered readers require current selection and candidate state. Retained ring bounds and duplicate layer execution checked before work. Zero-emission steps still update compressor rings and publish a fresh owner generation. Rewinds limited by retained projected history.
implementation.synchronization: Existing pool publication, source index selection and attention completion fences retained. Numeric fixtures use two fences per owner call and one per sliding/borrowed call; gathered producing index sources add their existing index fence. No whole-forward asynchronous transaction claim.
implementation.failure: Metadata rejection preserves output; any backend/completion failure destroys request and invalidates all borrowed views until reset/setup. No whole-model position advance.

references.method: Original unmodified norm/RoPE/compression CABI bodies, original attention kernels/SMEM picker and grouped projection/LinearFP16.forward AST. Matmul policy matches system cuBLAS13.10; F32 original hgemm argument/workspace policy replay, not compiled full PyTorch extension.
references.synthetic: 28 frames, H64 D512 G8; hidden/Q-rank/output-rank128; nonzero synthetic FP8/BF16 projections and gamma1.
references.checkpoint: 28 frames with actual immutable checkpoint QKV/compressor/key/output matrices, norms and learned sinks, hidden5120/Q-rank1280/output-rank1024. Synthetic normalized input activations; not full-model hidden states or generation.
references.sharing: Sliding layer0, gated owner2/reader3, and independent gateless owner20 sequence. Includes R273 prefill, R1 decode, partial windows,32/33 boundary, compressor ring wraps, zero-emission step, resumed chunks and41-token rewind.
references.frequency: Explicit preserved original-source main/compress frequency tables; model-native frequency construction still open.
